title: Application log line
description: One JSON object per line on stdout. Every service writes this shape; the platform reads it. See README.md in this folder.

service.description: Deployable unit, same name as the folder under services/.

component.description: Process or module inside the service, for example api, bureau-consumer.

event.description: Stable machine name of what happened, lower case with dots, for filtering and alerts. Use 'log' when a line has no named event yet.

message.description: Sentence for a person. Put data in fields, not in the sentence.

trace_id.description: W3C trace id of the active span (32 hex). The same application keeps the same trace id across services.

stack.description: Whole stack trace as one string, so the line stays one line.

fields.description: Anything else worth keeping. Values of keys listed in sensitive_fields.json are replaced by [REDACTED].
